question: Is the six-process local LanceDB proof, together with the `existOk` contract and green exact-head checks, sufficient to merge this persistent-store initialization change without a representative remote-object-store concurrency run?
rationale: The patch changes startup behavior for a storage backend that can use remote URIs; current evidence is strong for the local backend but does not independently demonstrate the remote path, and the protected label requires a human to set the release-risk boundary.

options.title: Accept the bounded residual risk
options.body: Merge after normal exact-merge gating, relying on LanceDB’s documented create contract and the local multi-process regression as sufficient proof for this narrow fix.

options.title: Require remote-store proof
options.body: Keep the PR paused until the contributor or owner demonstrates concurrent initialization against one supported remote object-store configuration.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded residual risk
